title: Zero effective HP exhaustion clamp for player-character combatants
description: S14 of eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8.3 exposed a sibling-scope boundary. With hp_max=1, hp_current=1, and player-character death rules, adjust_exhaustion(delta:4) derives effectiveHpMax=0 and calls updateCombatant with hpDelta:-1. updateCombatant currently compares overflow (0) against the zero effective maximum and records status dead; the required existing 0-HP lifecycle is dying, without instant death. Repair encounterCombatants.ts and retain a regression proving player-character combatant clamps at zero become dying while monster combatants follow monster death rules. Do not change the uniform floor(max/2) calculation.
acceptance_criteria: A one-HP player-character combatant clamped by level-four exhaustion becomes dying, and a monster combatant follows monster death rules; regression tests exercise both.
close_reason: Fixed in the integration PR (eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8) at e601316c: instant death needs overflow > 0, so a zero effective maximum clamp leaves a player-character combatant dying; regression in exhaustion.test.ts.
